title: Nathan Latka
source: Luma (Wake Up! CPG Austin event listing)
summary: Featured at Austin's Wake Up! CPG meetup, whose listing calls him the most active CPG investor in Austin, says he will invest $50M in Austin CPG brands this year and names Pecan Cakes, Parker & Scott and Gordoughs Donuts; the listing links to Founderpath, which published a $40K financing for Texas Pecan Cakes. Claims are promotional and unverified; event date not confirmed.
why_relevant: Austin capital source actively courting local CPG brands; verify terms first, since the documented deal is financing rather than equity.
